        return pow(p, p, MOD)
    order = 1
    cur = k
    while cur != 1:

        order += 1

MOD = 10 ** 9 + 7

class Solver:
    def __init__(self, p, k):
        self.p = p
        self.k = k

    def order(self):
        p, k = self.p, self.k
        order = 1
        cur = k
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            order += 1
        return order

    def answer(self):
        if self.k == 0:
            return pow(self.p, self.p - 1, MOD)
        if self.k == 1:
            return pow(self.p, self.p, MOD)
        return pow(self.p, (self.p - 1) / self.order(), MOD)
